newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu to return soon to Zaire -- state radio.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to return soon to Zaire -- state radio.

text.p: President Mobutu Sese Seko's doctors were happy with the results of medical tests he had in Europe last week and he will return to Zaire after a few days rest, state radio reported on Wednesday.

Mobutu arrived in Europe last Thursday after a three week visit to Zaire where he reshuffled the government and senior ranks of the military to bolster the war against rebels who have seized territory in the east of the sprawling nation.

Mobutu spent four months in Europe in 1996 on chemotherapy, after undergoing prostate surgery in Switzerland in late August and returned to Zaire after the rebels had already taken a large chunk of territory.

The radio, quoting the president's security advisor Honore Ngbanda, said Mobutu returned to his Cap-Martin villa in the South of France on Friday after routine tests in Monaco lasting just a few hours.
"The president had to return to France to undergo a routine checkup already scheduled by his doctors," state radio said.
"The day after his arrival in Nice, the president underwent examinations for several hours only and to the great satisfaction of his doctors," it added.
"The president returned immediately to his Cap-Martin residence where he will rest for a few days before returning to the country (Zaire)," it said.
The radio dismissed rumours in the national and international press that Zaire's ruler of 31 years would undergo fresh surgery for cancer, saying they were based on malicious political speculation.
